title: Blue Runner Sportfishing

services.name: Fishing Details
services.desc: Please board the vessel at 5 AM. EVERYONE MUST BE ON BOARD WITH A CURRENT CALIFORNIA SPORTFISHING LICENSE TO CHECK IN NO LATER THAN 5:15 AM. We depart as soon as all anglers are on the boat and checked in. Advance reservations are required. We usually return no later than 4 PM. Blue Runner Charters offers top-rated fishing trips out of Sausalito, giving you fast access to the best fishing grounds in Northern California. Whether you’re heading offshore for rockfish and lingcod or exploring the calm waters of San Francisco Bay for halibut and striped bass, we have trips for every skill level.
